A hotel with a grill at its heart

Del's pairs comfortable rooms with a kitchen guests actually plan their day around. Wake up to breakfast, spend the afternoon at the pool, and finish with dinner from the grill.

Every room includes complimentary breakfast, free pool access, free Wi-Fi, a hot and cold shower, air conditioning and cable TV. Our loft room adds a sleeping mezzanine for a third guest.

Good to know

How do I book a room?

Use the booking bar above to send a request by text message, or call 0948 867 3546. We will confirm availability and the rate.

What is a loft room?

A room with a double bed on the floor and a second sleeping platform above it, reached by a built-in staircase.

Can non-guests eat at the restaurant?

Yes. The grill and restaurant is open to everyone. Call ahead for large groups.

Is pool access included?

Yes. Pool access is free for hotel guests.

What is included in the room rate?

Every room includes complimentary breakfast, free pool access, free Wi-Fi, a hot and cold shower, air conditioning and cable TV.

How much is a room?

Rates start at ₱1,150 per night for a single regular room and go up to ₱3,200 per night for the family premium room. See the full list in the rooms section, and confirm the current rate when you book.

Do you host events and group stays?

Yes. Tell us your date, headcount and occasion through the contact form or by phone, and we will plan with you.

Where are you?

On the Pan-Philippine Highway, Barangay Karaos, San Francisco, Agusan del Sur, 8501.
